name: PT Forza Land Indonesia Tbk
summary: PT Forza Land Indonesia Tbk operates as a property developer within Indonesia, focusing on a broad spectrum of real estate projects. Their portfolio encompasses the construction of industrial estates, residential complexes such as apartments and condominiums, commercial developments including office buildings and retail outlets, and various other housing initiatives. Founded in 2012, the company was initially known as PT Megah Satu Properti, rebranding to its current name, PT Forza Land Indonesia Tbk, in 2016. Its principal office is situated in Jakarta Barat, Indonesia.
